You can date the bottle to know the age of the contained milk, or name the bottle so no mix-up in the daycare refrigerator ✓ Fits nipples and collar rings for wide-neck bottles (See Compatibility) ✓ Pump diectly into these the bottles, so no transfers of breastmilk, and no Waste of milk. ✓ Reusable and BPA free CLEANING All parts can be sanitised with water steam or boiling water
2010529583.detail_html:
Maymom Wide-Neck Milk Bottle with SureSeal Silicone Disc is a wide-neck milk bottle from Maymom with a collar and a sealing disc. Use it to store, feed and pump milk. The SureSeal silicone disc protects against milk leakage.

• Wide-Neck collar and silicone disc storage/feeding bottle

• Silicone SureSeal sealing disc ensures 100% leak proof

• 5ml measurement marks

• SureSeal silicone top can be marked and erased by washing - date your milk!

• Pump straight into bottle and feed straight from bottle - zero milk wastage

• Reusable and BPA free

To ensure a tighter fit between the flange and the wide-neck bottles, we advise purchasing o-rings to be installed on the wide-neck flange.

COMPATIBILITY

✓ Compatible with Spectra & Maymom Wide-Mouth Flange

✓ Compatible with Spectra Breastpumps, Avent Isis, Electric and Manual Pump

✓ Compatible Nipples: Maymom, Spectra & Avent Nipples

✓ Compatible Bottles: Spectra, Avent Anti-Colic, Avent Natural Collars

FEATURES & DETAILS

✓ Wide-neck bottles

✓ 4.7oz/140ml breastmilk collection or storage bottles

✓ Fits nipples and collar rings for wide-neck bottles (See Compatibility)

✓ Pump diectly into these the bottles, so no transfers of breastmilk, and no Waste of milk.

✓ Reusable and BPA free

CLEANING

All parts can be sanitised with water steam or boiling water

1695186547.detail_text: EzPz Mini Feeding Set includes the Mini Mat, Mini Spoon and Mini Fork to help your toddler with feeding independence. As your infant transitions to toddlerhood, they are ready to start practicing new mealtime milestones. They are eating a balanced meal with different food groups and are learning how to eat with a spoon (scooping) and fork (piercing). This set provides all of the developmental tools you need for independent mealtime with your toddler. Includes Mini Mat, Mini Spoon and Mini Fork Fork and Spoon with strong nylon head for easier scooping and piercing Non-slip grip, sensory bumps and easy-grasp handle. Mini Mat is an integrated placemat and bowl Suctions to the tray to keep messes in check. Mini Mat with three compartments (in adorable happy face shape) encourage well-balanced meals. Stable base promotes self-feeding and fine motor skills Helps your toddler succeed with feeding independence Hypo-Allergenic 100% Toxin-Free Silicone BPA, BPS, PVS, phthalate and latex free Dishwasher safe Recommended for 12+ months. Product Details + Benefits: Set includes [1] Mini Mat, [1] Mini Spoon and [1] Mini Fork 100% Silicone (BPA, BPS, PVS, phthalate and latex free) Mini Mat Dimensions: 10.75 x 7.75 x 1 in Portion sizes (i.e., the eyes and smile) are catered to infants at 2oz, 2oz and 4oz Mat fits most highchair trays, including 'space saver' models Dishwasher, microwave and oven safe (up to 350 degrees) Built to last (silicone will not wear, fade or corrode)

They are eating a balanced meal with different food groups and are learning how to eat with a spoon (scooping) and fork (piercing). This set provides all of the developmental tools you need for independent mealtime with your toddler.

  • Includes Mini Mat, Mini Spoon and Mini Fork
  • Fork and Spoon with strong nylon head for easier scooping and piercing
  • Non-slip grip, sensory bumps and easy-grasp handle.
  • Mini Mat is an integrated placemat and bowl
  • Suctions to the tray to keep messes in check.
  • Mini Mat with three compartments (in adorable happy face shape) encourage well-balanced meals.
  • Stable base promotes self-feeding and fine motor skills
  • Helps your toddler succeed with feeding independence
  • Hypo-Allergenic
  • 100% Toxin-Free Silicone
  • BPA, BPS, PVS, phthalate and latex free
  • Dishwasher safe

Recommended for 12+ months.

Product Details + Benefits:

Set includes [1] Mini Mat, [1] Mini Spoon and [1] Mini Fork

100% Silicone (BPA, BPS, PVS, phthalate and latex free)

Mini Mat Dimensions: 10.75 x 7.75 x 1 in

Portion sizes (i.e., the eyes and smile) are catered to infants at 2oz, 2oz and 4oz

Mat fits most highchair trays, including 'space saver' models

Dishwasher, microwave and oven safe (up to 350 degrees)

Built to last (silicone will not wear, fade or corrode)

brand.suggestion: More Feeding Essentials from Skip Hop

product.desc:
Skip Hop Zoo Insulated Food Jar is a colorful stainless steel container that keeps kid-sized portions warm or cold. Store the included spork, or most utensils, in the handy built-in holder so your little one is ready for meals on-the-go. Its stainless steel body is lightweight yet sturdy for kids and even has a built in holder that fits most utensils.

  • Stainless steel body keeps food warm for 7 hours or cold for 5 hours
  • Built in holder stores and fits most utensils, perfect for on-the-go.
  • Includes a spork (utensil that is both a spoon+fork!)
  • Premium stainless steel container features an easy open twist lid that toddler's little hands can open.
  • BPA-free, Phthalate-free
  • Holds 325 mL (11 fl oz)

Recommended for ages 3+ years.

13807522434.detail_html:
Product Description

Philips Avent Silicone Baby Divided Suction Plate

Make self-feeding easier and cleaner for your little one aged 6 months and up! Our food-grade silicone divided plate combines antibacterial function, one-piece molding and anti-static surface treatment, an ideal daily tableware for toddlers learning to eat independently.

✨ Core Product Highlights

  1. 99.9% Effective Antibacterial Protection
    Built-in antibacterial material inhibits common bacteria growth on the surface, effectively keep baby’s meal clean and safe every day.
  2. Integrated One-Piece Molding Design
    Seamless whole body without gaps, no hidden food residue. Super easy to rinse clean in seconds, no stubborn dirt stuck inside.
  3. Anti-Static Surface, No Dust Sticking
    Special anti-static surface treatment prevents static adsorption, will not attract dust and hair. Silicone touch is soft and delicate, gentle on baby’s hands.
  4. Strong Bottom Suction Cup
    Powerful suction base sticks tightly to smooth high chair trays, tables and countertops. Avoid spills and tableware flipping when babies grab food by themselves.
  5. 3 Compartment Divided Layout
    Independent separated zones for staple food, fruits and side dishes. Separate different meals without flavor mixing, cultivate baby’s good eating habits.
  6. Safe Food-Grade Liquid Silicone
    Made of premium liquid silicone, BPA, PVC and phthalate free. Wide temperature resistance from -20℃ to 220℃, safe for refrigerator storage, steaming and disinfection.
  7. Practical Hidden Pull Tab
    Convenient hidden pull tab design for effortless removal of the plate after meals, no struggle to lift the suction tray.
  8. Smooth Burr-Free Surface
    Fine polished edges with zero sharp burrs, fully protect baby’s tender oral skin and small hands during feeding.

Product Specifications

  • Item Name: Baby Divided Silicone Suction Plate (No Lid)

  • Color: Amber Gold

  • Material: Food-Grade Liquid Silicone

  • Total Capacity: 895ml

  • Size: 190mm × 45mm

  • Applicable Age: Over 6 Months Old

  • Temperature Resistance: -20℃ ~ 220℃

  • Feature: Antibacterial, Anti-static, One-piece Mold, Strong Suction, Easy to Clean

Cleaning & Care Guide

  1. Rinse with warm water and mild detergent after each use, wipe dry for storage.

  2. Safe for steam sterilizer, boiling water disinfection and refrigerator use.

  3. Do not use hard metal brushes to scrub the surface to avoid scratches.

13803165201.detail_text: Brand new • Food grade silicone suction that prevent spills, flips and throws from weaning babies • 100% natural bamboo protect your toddler from BPA, phthalates and other toxins • Approved from the strictest regulatory SGS and all other food safety requirements • Heat resistance bamboo can take heat up to 400 degrees, no worries for making hot soups or porridge • Serves as a perfect reminder to offer different varieties of food and helps to get into the habit of doing that at each meal • The walls of partitions help your little one push food onto a spoon • Removable suction base lets you transition to regular use when your child outgrows them • Dimensions: L:18cm |W: 18cm |H: 4cm Will it stick onto all surfaces? Our silicone suction base adheres best to smooth, non-porous surfaces such as plastic, tile, glass, fibreglass or metal. High chairs or wooden surfaces that are textured, porous or have slight curves will make it difficult to achieve lasting suction power. The suction ring should be completely flush to the base of the bowl or plate, to prevent air suction loss, causing the plate to rise. To ensure a firm bond, surfaces should be totally free of dirt and soap film before attaching the plate. Not suitable for dishwasher or microwave usage, hand wash only. --- :HGlcab #MCK #Bamboo Plate #Silicone Suction

To ensure a firm bond, surfaces should be totally free of dirt and soap film before attaching the plate.

Not suitable for dishwasher or microwave usage, hand wash only.

• Approved from the strictest regulatory SGS and all other food safety requirements

• Heat resistance bamboo can take heat up to 400 degrees, no worries for making hot soups or porridge

• Serves as a perfect reminder to offer different varieties of food and helps to get into the habit of doing that at each meal

• The walls of partitions help your little one push food onto a spoon

• Removable suction base lets you transition to regular use when your child outgrows them

• Dimensions: L:18cm |W: 18cm |H: 4cm

Will it stick onto all surfaces?

Our silicone suction base adheres best to smooth, non-porous surfaces such as plastic, tile, glass, fibreglass or metal. High chairs or wooden surfaces that are textured, porous or have slight curves will make it difficult to achieve lasting suction power.

The suction ring should be completely flush to the base of the bowl or plate, to prevent air suction loss, causing the plate to rise.

To ensure a firm bond, surfaces should be totally free of dirt and soap film before attaching the plate.

Not suitable for dishwasher or microwave usage, hand wash only.

MPJ Trilaminate 999 Silver Nursing Cups is a pair of nursing cups crafted using trilaminate technology. Each cup features two layers of 999 silver with a reinforced inner copper core. Designed for nursing mothers experiencing sore or cracked nipples, these cups provide natural relief while protecting delicate skin from friction and irritation. The silver surface naturally helps maintain a clean environment on the skin, while the durable construction resists bending better than pure silver alone.

  • Contains 2 Trilaminate 999 Silver Nursing Nipple Cups
  • Alleviate discomfort and soothe sore nipples
  • Promotes healing of cracked nipples and prevents infection
  • Safe for sensitive skin
  • No harsh chemicals or artificial ingredients
  • Comfortable and discreet
  • Designed to fit snugly over your nipples
  • Hypoallergenic and Nickel-free
  • Small: 3.5g, Large: 4.2g

While breastfeeding offers a rewarding experience, it can pose discomfort, particularly for new mothers. Sore nipples frequently emerge as a common issue, rendering breastfeeding a painful and challenging endeavour. Thankfully, there exist natural remedies to alleviate this discomfort and enhance the overall joy of breastfeeding. Among these remedies, MPJ Nursing Cups stand out as a promising solution!

Trilaminate 999 Silver or 999 Silver Nursing Cups? 

Trilaminate 999 Silver Nursing Cups feature a layered construction, typically with a supportive copper core sandwiched between layers of 999 silver. The outer silver layer still comes into contact with the skin, providing the natural antimicrobial and soothing benefits of silver, while the multilayer design improves durability and helps the cups maintain their shape.

Trilaminate silver nursing cups are also generally more affordable, as they use less silver while still delivering the key benefits of silver nursing cups, with the added advantage of stronger structural integrity.

999 Silver Nursing Cups, on the other hand, are made entirely from 99.9% pure silver. They provide the same natural antibacterial and healing properties but are softer due to the purity of the metal, which means they may bend or lose their shape more easily compared to trilaminate versions.

Natural Anti-inflammatory and Antibacterial Properties

Silver is known for its powerful anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. These properties help reduce swelling, redness, and irritation in the nipple area, providing relief from soreness and discomfort. The anti-bacterial properties help prevent infection, which can further accelerate the healing process.

Soothes Cracked and Damaged Nipples

Experiencing pain from cracked or damaged nipples can be excruciating. The sleek surface of silver nursing cups establishes a protective shield, effectively halting additional friction and irritation. Additionally, the anti-inflammatory characteristics of silver actively contribute to the healing process, working to reduce the discomfort linked with cracked nipples.

Hypoallergenic and Gentle on Sensitive Skin:

As a naturally hypoallergenic material, silver ensures a safe option for even the most sensitive skin, a crucial consideration for mothers with delicate nipples or skin conditions such as eczema.

Comfortable and Unobtrusive:

Crafted for a snug fit over the nipple, silver nursing cups prioritize both comfort and discretion. Wear them comfortably beneath clothing without drawing attention.

Some mothers even found that using Silver Nursing Cups helps improve milk flow - largely attributed to the enhanced comfort and reduced stress and pain!

How to use:

  • Clean the cups with warm water before first use.
  • After breastfeeding, place a few drops of breast milk inside the cup (optional).
  • Position the cup over the nipple and wear inside your bra.
  • Remove and rinse before the next feeding. 

Tips! Recommended to express a few drops of breastmilk onto the nursing cups before use. For a layer of moisture and helps cups stay in place.

Kangaroo feeding tubes are designed to provide nutrition, fluids, and medications to patients who are unable to take them orally. Here are their key functions and benefits:

Singapore Approval reseller Safe to use for Local Buyer.

Nutritional Support:

Enteral Feeding: These tubes deliver nutrition directly to the stomach or small intestine, ensuring patients receive the necessary nutrients.

Hydration: They also help in maintaining proper hydration by delivering fluids directly to the gastrointestinal tract.

Medication Administration:

Safe Delivery: Medications can be administered through the feeding tube, ensuring they reach the digestive system effectively.

Versatility:

Multiple Types: Kangaroo feeding tubes come in various types, including nasogastric, nasoduodenal, and gastrostomy tubes, catering to different medical needs.

IRIS Technology: Some models, like the Kangaroo feeding tube with IRIS technology, use a video stream to aid in accurate placement.

Safety Features:

Secure Connections: The feeding ports are designed to be incompatible with luer lock or IV connections, reducing the risk of accidental connections.

Durability: Made from durable materials like silicone, these tubes are designed for optimal performance and longevity.

These features make Kangaroo feeding tubes essential for patients requiring enteral feeding and medication administration

Size available: 12Fr or 14Fr

袋鼠喂食管旨在为无法口服的患者提供营养、液体和药物。以下是它们的主要功能和好处：

营养支持：

肠内喂养：这些管子将营养直接输送到胃或小肠，确保患者获得必要的营养。

补水：它们还通过将液体直接输送到胃肠道来帮助保持适当的补水。

药物管理：

安全输送：药物可以通过喂食管给药，确保它们有效到达消化系统。

多功能性：

多种类型：袋鼠喂食管有多种类型，包括鼻胃管、鼻十二指肠管和胃造口管，可满足不同的医疗需求。

IRIS 技术：某些型号，如采用 IRIS 技术的袋鼠喂食管，使用视频流来帮助准确放置。

安全功能：

安全连接：喂食口设计为与鲁尔锁或 IV 连接不兼容，从而降低了意外连接的风险。

耐用性：这些管子由硅胶等耐用材料制成，旨在实现最佳性能和使用寿命。

这些功能使袋鼠喂食管成为需要肠内喂养和药物给药的患者必不可少的用品

Kangaroo feeding tubes are designed to provide nutrition, fluids, and medications to patients who are unable to take them orally. Here are their key functions and benefits:

Nutritional Support:

Enteral Feeding: These tubes deliver nutrition directly to the stomach or small intestine, ensuring patients receive the necessary nutrients.

Hydration: They also help in maintaining proper hydration by delivering fluids directly to the gastrointestinal tract.

Medication Administration:

Safe Delivery: Medications can be administered through the feeding tube, ensuring they reach the digestive system effectively.

Versatility:

Multiple Types: Kangaroo feeding tubes come in various types, including nasogastric, nasoduodenal, and gastrostomy tubes, catering to different medical needs.

IRIS Technology: Some models, like the Kangaroo feeding tube with IRIS technology, use a video stream to aid in accurate placement.

Safety Features:

Secure Connections: The feeding ports are designed to be incompatible with luer lock or IV connections, reducing the risk of accidental connections.

Durability: Made from durable materials like silicone, these tubes are designed for optimal performance and longevity.

These features make Kangaroo feeding tubes essential for patients requiring enteral feeding and medication administration

Size available: 12Fr or 14Fr

肠内喂养：这些管子将营养直接输送到胃或小肠，确保患者获得必要的营养。

补水：它们还通过将液体直接输送到胃肠道来帮助保持适当的补水。

药物管理：

安全连接：喂食口设计为与鲁尔锁或 IV 连接不兼容，从而降低了意外连接的风险。

耐用性：这些管子由硅胶等耐用材料制成，旨在实现最佳性能和使用寿命。

这些功能使袋鼠喂食管成为需要肠内喂养和药物给药的患者必不可少的用品

可用尺寸：12Fr 或 14Fr
